chunks: From the servant of Allāh, ‘Alī, Amīr al-mu’minīn to the Officer-in-charge of garrisons :

key_terms.أَصْحَابِ الْمَسَالِحِ: Officers-in-charge of garrisons / holders of weapons

ai.seo_question: Who is the sender and who are the recipients in this opening of Imam Ali's letter?
ai.summary: This salutation serves as the formal header for Imam ‘Alī’s directive to the military commanders, establishing his dual role as both political leader and spiritual guide during the early Caliphate. It reflects the administrative structure of the Rashidun era, where 'As-hab al-Masalih' referred to officers responsible for logistics, arms, and troop management, underscoring the integration of military discipline with divine authority.
